_about: Astro Precise — the £12 Deep Reading (seven chapters). Companion to reading-templates.json. Every chapter opens with mono receipts, then serif meaning the receipts earn. Whole-sign houses only when birth time known. Tradition framed for reflection, never prediction.

signThemes.Taurus: steady, sensual, loyal to what lasts
signThemes.Gemini: quick, curious, fluent in almost everything
signThemes.Leo: warm, expressive, made to be seen
signThemes.Capricorn: patient, structural, built for the long climb
signThemes.Pisces: porous, imaginative, tuned to the unseen

elements.fire: Fire runs on ignition — you move when something lights.
elements.earth: Earth runs on substance — you trust what can be touched and kept.
elements.air: Air runs on connection — you think by talking and link by nature.
elements.water: Water runs on feeling — you know things before you can say them.

modalities.cardinal: You are built to begin; starting is the muscle you trained.
modalities.fixed: You are built to hold; finishing and keeping are your gifts.
modalities.mutable: You are built to adapt; you bend where others break.

ch1.title: The sky at your first breath
ch1.serif: Everything in this reading is built from the positions above — computed from raw astronomy for your exact moment, not looked up, not invented. Where the words go further than the numbers, they say so. That is the whole contract.

ch2.title: The three lights
ch2.sun: Your Sun is the running engine — {theme}.
ch2.moon: Your Moon is what you need before you can explain why — {theme}.
ch2.asc: Your Ascendant is the door you meet the world through — {theme}.
ch2.noAsc: Your rising sign needs a birth time we don't have — so this reading stays honestly with the two lights we can fix exactly. If you ever find your birth time, the third light is waiting.

ch4.title: Where the weight falls
ch4.intro: Of every pair of planets in your chart, these sit closest — the contacts tradition reads as the standing conversations of a life:
ch4.pairFrame: {a} and {b} in {aspect} ({orb}) — {aTheme} {verb} {bTheme}. Neither wins; the conversation is the point.

ch5.title: The long arcs
ch5.saturn: Saturn in {sign}{house} — your patience and your load: where you were given less for free, and built more that lasts.
ch5.uranus: Uranus in {sign}{house} — where you refuse the given order and keep a window open.
ch5.neptune: Neptune in {sign}{house} — where the edges soften: your longing, your imagination, your sea.
ch5.pluto: Pluto in {sign}{house} — the slow engine room: what transforms across decades, not days.

ch6.title: This season's sky
ch6.intro: Where the sky right now touches the sky you were born under — the living, checkable part of this reading:
ch6.noTransits: The live edition of this chapter is computed on the day you read it — open your chart on the site and this page fills with today's true contacts, dated to the minute.

ch7.title: A letter to keep
ch7.body: If you reread nothing else, reread this. The closest conversation in your chart — {tightPair} — is not a flaw to fix; it is the friction that makes you specific. Your {domElement} nature will keep doing what it does: {domElementLine} Let it. Nothing in your sky needs repairing. It needs living — openly, and in your own order. The sky above tonight is already different from the one on page one; you are allowed to be, too.
